mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts only after the full sequence (recast/effect) resolves, not on initial cast.
Both the initial pass and the recast pass deal the same base damage listed, each as an activation event.
mechanics.quote: Both casts count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: Despite being two separate activations, they count as the same cast instance for effects that key off casts.
mechanics.quote: Despite this, the effects of both casts count as the same {{tip|cast instance}}.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield can only block one of the two passes, so the other pass's damage still lands.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield|Spell shields}} may only block one pass.

mechanics.claim: Each enemy can only be hit once per pass (not multiple times), limiting damage instances per pass.
Ornn is locked out of all actions during the recast dash and for 0.5s afterward, delaying his next action (relevant to attack/ability sequencing in the damage fight).
mechanics.quote: '''Ornn''' becomes locked out of all actions during the recast's dash and for {{fd|0.5}} seconds afterwards.
